text: だいじに　そだてた　ポケモン！

structure.jp: だいじに　そだてた

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: だいじに　そだてた　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb right before a thing describes that thing. だいじに そだてた ポケモン = 'the Pokémon I raised with care'.

patterns.name: 〜に (how)
patterns.explanation: に turns だいじ, 'precious', into 'carefully'. だいじに そだてた = 'raised with care'.
